description: Captures the Rack window or another visual source, blends two of them, transforms the result geometrically and in colour, and draws it back into its own display.

params.text: Freezes the capture on the frame showing when it is switched on; left off, the capture runs continuously.
Blends the two sources, -1 for source 1 on its own, 0 for an equal blend and +1 for source 2 on its own.
Turns that transform row on or off.
Zooms the image evenly, 0.1 to 4.0, with each volt of CV worth 0.3.
Attenuates and inverts the CV feeding that transform row.
Stretches the image horizontally, -5 to +5 mapped exponentially, negative settings mirroring it, with each volt of CV worth 0.5.
Stretches the image vertically, -5 to +5 mapped exponentially, negative settings mirroring it, with each volt of CV worth 0.5.
Rotates the image about the centre of the display, -180 to +180 degrees and wrapping beyond that, with each volt of CV worth 36 degrees.
Sets the kaleidoscope in whole steps from -12 to +12: 0 is off, positive values give flower rotational symmetry and negative values give two- and four-part kaleidoscopes.
Moves the image sideways by -1 to +1 of the image width and wraps round, with each volt of CV worth 0.1.
Moves the image up and down by -1 to +1 of the display height and wraps round, with each volt of CV worth 0.1.
Turns all the colours round the hue wheel, -360 to +360 degrees; positive moves them together and negative splits them and raises saturation and contrast, with each volt of CV worth 36 degrees.
Warps the colours, -1 to +1: positive posterises and crushes the contrast, negative solarises towards inversion, and full negative gives an inverted image, with each volt of CV worth 0.1.

inputs.text: A gate above 0.5V turns that transform row on and a low gate turns it off, overriding the row's button.
Modulates that transform row through the row's attenuverter.
A gate above 0.5V forces the freeze on and a low gate forces continuous capture, overriding the button.
Adds a fifth of its voltage to the mix knob, the result clamped to the -1 to +1 range.

notes: with the mouse over the module, Q toggles edit mode and A cycles the mouse mapping between translate with scale on the wheel, and axis scale with rotation on the wheel.
the module is resized by dragging its right edge, and an image file dropped onto it loads into source 2.
source 2 comes up set to an image with no file chosen, so the mix knob turned towards source 2 shows nothing until an image is loaded or dropped on.
menu: Source 1 — sets what the first source captures: Full Rack Window, Load image, Select rack rectangle, Select window rectangle or a chosen Module; Clear source empties it.
Fold Frequency — a slider under the Color Warp heading, raising the colour fold frequency from 1.0 to 4.0 and widening the chromatic divergence.
Algorithm — chooses whether the kaleidoscope runs before the translation or after it.
Minimize UI — strips the panel art, controls, labels and jack graphics so that only the display is left, holding the right edge in place.
Render as rack background — draws the visual behind the modules as well as in the display.
Transform when frozen — keeps the knobs and CV active on a frozen frame instead of freezing the transform settings along with it.
Visual — holds Tile empty space, Maintain aspect ratio and Crop Rack Window Borders.
Dim visuals with room — makes the render follow Rack's room brightness setting.
Blend mode — sets how the two sources are combined: Crossfade, Normal, Add, Subtract, Multiply, Screen, Overlay, Difference, Darken, Lighten or XOR.
Full Rack BG — holds Empty module window, which leaves the display itself transparent, and sliders for Backdrop Alpha, Backdrop Darken and Backdrop Blur.
Source 2 — sets what the second source captures, with the same items as Source 1; the menu item is printed with the source in use after the name.
